# Alepo

> AAA and BSS software for telecom operators and ISPs, with AI built in.

- [AAA and BSS software for telecom operators](https://alepo.com/): Alepo makes AAA, policy, charging, billing and customer care software for telecom operators and ISPs, with AI built in. Request a demo.
- [Telecom software products](https://alepo.com/products/): 21 products for telecom operators and ISPs: AAA and TACACS+, billing and charging, provisioning, customer care and AI. Each runs alone or together.
- [Solutions for telecom operators](https://alepo.com/solutions/): Start from the network you run: fibre and cable ISPs, mobile operators, MVNOs and MVNEs, Wi-Fi and venues, or enterprise and government networks.
- [Services and support](https://alepo.com/services/): On premises or SaaS, by subscription. Alepo engineers handle migration, testing and training, and GTAC gives 24x7 technical support.
- [AI for telecom operators](https://alepo.com/products/ai-for-telecom/): AI in telecom operations: agents that watch each Alepo product, assistants for care and NOC staff, and a person approves every change.
- [Customer stories](https://alepo.com/customers/): How operators such as STC, Digicel, SaskTel and Wind Telecom upgraded AAA, migrated BSS and launched new brands on Alepo.
- [About Alepo](https://alepo.com/company/about/): Alepo Technologies has built telecom software for over two decades, from Austin, Texas, with teams across the Americas, India and Africa.
- [Leadership](https://alepo.com/company/leadership/): The team that runs Alepo across product, delivery, sales and support, led by founder and CEO Jonathan Garini.
- [Partner program](https://alepo.com/company/partners/): Resellers and system integrators deliver Alepo products in their own markets, including Nomios, Italtel and Blue Arcus. Apply to become a partner.
- [Security](https://alepo.com/company/security/): How Alepo protects operator data: encryption, access control, privacy, 24x7 monitoring, AI safeguards and incident response, on premises or as SaaS.
- [Careers at Alepo](https://alepo.com/company/careers/): Build telecom software that runs on live operator networks. Open roles in Navi Mumbai, Pune, the United States and Latin America.
- [News and events](https://alepo.com/news/): Customer wins, product launches, partnerships and the events where you can meet Alepo.
- [Resources](https://alepo.com/resources/): Guides for people who run operator networks, product datasheets, case studies and news from Alepo.
- [Blog](https://alepo.com/blog/): Practical guides on RADIUS, TACACS+, Diameter, charging, policy, BSS and AI for the people who run operator networks.
- [Library](https://alepo.com/library/): Download Alepo datasheets, case studies and white papers in English and Spanish. Datasheets need no form.
- [Contact Alepo](https://alepo.com/contact-us/): Request a demo, talk to sales, submit an RFP or reach 24x7 support. Offices in the United States, Latin America, India and Africa.
- [Software for fibre and cable ISPs](https://alepo.com/solutions/fibre-cable-isps/): ISP software for FTTH, cable and fixed-wireless providers: AAA, activation, home router management, billing and collections. Start with one product.
- [Software for mobile operators](https://alepo.com/solutions/mobile-operators/): Real-time charging and policy, Wi-Fi offload and calling, and one BSS for prepaid and postpaid, beside the core and systems you already run.
- [Software for MVNOs and MVNEs](https://alepo.com/solutions/mvnos-mvnes/): A defined launch package for new MVNO brands, and real-time charging and partner settlement for MVNEs that host several brands.
- [Captive portal and carrier Wi-Fi for venues and operators](https://alepo.com/solutions/wifi-venues/): Captive portal software for venues and carrier Wi-Fi for mobile operators: branded logins, paid passes and automatic SIM login on existing access points.
- [Device administration for enterprise and government networks](https://alepo.com/solutions/enterprise-government-networks/): Replace Cisco ACS and local device passwords with one TACACS+ server: a login per engineer, per-command authorization and a tamper-evident audit trail.
- [AAA Server for telecom operators](https://alepo.com/products/aaa-server/): RADIUS and Diameter AAA server for fibre, cable, Wi-Fi and mobile operators. Apply plan changes to live sessions and see every session in one console.
- [Service Provisioning and Activation](https://alepo.com/products/service-provisioning/): Telecom provisioning with Fulfilment Manager: each activation, suspension and plan change reaches the right network element, confirmed per customer.
- [TACACS+ Server for network device administration](https://alepo.com/products/tacacs-server/): TACACS+ server for every router, switch and firewall login: a login per engineer, per-command authorization and an audit trail sent to your SIEM.
- [Wi-Fi Offload and Calling for mobile operators](https://alepo.com/products/wifi-offload-calling/): Mobile subscribers join Wi-Fi with their SIM and keep calling over it. Venues get branded logins and paid passes on the access points already installed.
- [TR-069 and TR-369 device management](https://alepo.com/products/device-management/): TR-069 device management for home routers and ONTs: a TR-069 ACS and TR-369 USP Controller on your own servers, with no per-device cloud fee.
- [Subscriber Data Management (HSS)](https://alepo.com/products/subscriber-data-management/): A home subscriber server for 4G and IMS voice that works with another vendor's 5G core, so 5G is added without replacing the 4G subscriber server.
- [Digital BSS for telecom operators](https://alepo.com/products/digital-bss/): One configurable BSS to sell, charge, bill, collect and serve customers across mobile, fibre and broadband. Take the modules you need, keep what works.
- [Online Charging System (OCS)](https://alepo.com/products/online-charging/): Online charging system (OCS) that charges every call, message and megabyte in real time. Change bundles and brands by configuration, not code.
- [Policy Control (PCRF)](https://alepo.com/products/policy-control/): PCRF policy control: sell data plans by speed, app, time or cap and enforce them in real time, beside other vendors' cores.
- [Prepaid Offers and Voucher Management](https://alepo.com/products/prepaid-offers-vouchers/): Mobile recharge and voucher software: prepaid plans, scratch-card and digital top-ups and bonuses, pushed to charging, policy and every channel.
- [Collections and Dunning for telecom](https://alepo.com/products/collections-dunning/): Telecom collections and dunning: automate reminders, late fees, barring and restoration for unpaid bills, with a different policy per customer segment.
- [Partner and MVNO Settlement](https://alepo.com/products/partner-mvno-settlement/): Telecom wholesale billing and partner settlement: onboard partners, rate their traffic and invoice carriers, MVNOs and resellers without spreadsheets.
- [Telecom Dealer App and Mobile POS](https://alepo.com/products/dealer-mobile-pos/): Sign-up, SIM activation, top-ups and bill payments on a dealer's or field agent's phone, with every sale recorded in CRM, billing and inventory.
- [Telecom CRM for customer care](https://alepo.com/products/crm/): Telecom CRM for care agents: one page per customer with plans, billing, tickets and inventory, configurable processes and a built-in AI assistant.
- [Telecom Self-Care Portal](https://alepo.com/products/self-care-portal/): Self-service portal software for telecom: a branded site where subscribers sign up, pay and get help, connected to Alepo CRM and the AI Virtual Agent.
- [White-label telecom self-care app](https://alepo.com/products/self-care-app/): An iOS and Android app under your brand. Subscribers check usage, recharge, pay bills and change plans from their phone, with low-balance alerts.
- [BSS in a Box for MVNOs](https://alepo.com/products/bss-in-a-box/): MVNO billing platform packaged for launch: self-care, CRM, billing, charging and mobile POS in one defined offer, each brand on its own deployment.
- [Interconnect and Roaming Settlement](https://alepo.com/products/interconnect-roaming-settlement/): Interconnect billing system for carrier interconnect and roaming traffic: rate, reconcile and settle with partner operators inside the Alepo stack.
- [Telecom mediation and revenue assurance](https://alepo.com/products/mediation-revenue-assurance/): Telecom mediation and revenue assurance: Mediation Studio cleans every usage record before billing, and a ledger per file shows nothing was lost.
- [AI Virtual Agent for telecom](https://alepo.com/products/ai-virtual-agent/): AI customer service for telecom: a virtual agent on your website and app that answers around the clock, completes account tasks and hands off to people.
- [AI Agent Assist for care and NOC teams](https://alepo.com/products/ai-agent-assist/): AI agent assist for telecom care and NOC teams: answers from live console data, explains bills and failures and suggests the next step. Read-only.
- [Network access and AAA for operators](https://alepo.com/products/network-access-aaa/): AAA, TACACS+, Wi-Fi offload and subscriber data management for fibre, cable, Wi-Fi and mobile operators, with RADIUS and Diameter on one platform.
- [Telecom billing software](https://alepo.com/products/billing-bss/): Billing, real-time charging, policy, mediation, collections and settlement for operators, MVNOs and ISPs. Take one module or the full suite.
- [Service provisioning and device management](https://alepo.com/products/provisioning-devices/): Activate, suspend and restore services across OLTs, HSS, policy and AAA, and manage home routers and ONTs remotely with TR-069 and TR-369.
- [Customer care and channels for telecom](https://alepo.com/products/customer-care-channels/): A care workspace for agents, branded web and app self-care for subscribers, and a mobile POS for dealers, all connected to billing and AI.
- [Sitemap](https://alepo.com/sitemap/): Every page on alepo.com: products by group, solutions, services, resources and company pages.
